title: NHKマイルCの後に・遠い光

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital charges through! At home on turf and dirt, this wonder has shown us her strength today!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff… I did it… I spent all my strength… with none to spare even for my oshis…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The sky is… so… far…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But there's a light…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, this light…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thunk!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Digital?! Wake up, Digital!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Mmm… Uhh…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Opera O… and… Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank goodness you woke up. I didn't know what to do.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Th-thanks… I'm still inexperienced, but I knew if I didn't push myself to the limit, I wouldn't be able to see the same scenery as my oshis.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But forget about that. What are you two doing here?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: We were watching you in secret since before the race began, clad in the garb of stadium vendors.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I didn't want to bother you, so that's why I didn't speak to you in the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, that explains that feeling I had…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's incredible! I can't believe you two would go to the trouble of coming to see me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Um… I should say… I think I learned a little something today!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I caught a glipse of why you, Opera O, forge such a bold path—and why you, Doto, chase glory so dazzlingly!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I finally get it… at least a little…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! You don't say. Although, I would be remiss if I failed to point out that my magnificence was inherited at birth.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But if you're intent on worshipping me so, why don't I show you something even more resplendent?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Of course, I'm speaking of our very first competitive performance, a showdown between Doto and myself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ooh… a showdown! Unbelievable!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm finally running a G1. Of course, I'm just one of many though.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But I finally get to run with my hero Opera O at the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hrngh!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Digital!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The heavens crumble! My oshis are going big?! This is like a dome concert-level holy event!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll have to prepare a feast for the goddesses in appreciation of how good I'm eating right now!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! By all means, come and watch. In return…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: There is an arc to your story which you have not yet revealed. Is this not so?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I hear talk of you being a so-called "all-rounder" who performs with equally sure footing—no matter the stage.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Today, you performed on turf. Thus, I expect you have one more act up your sleeve.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: If I'm not mistaken, there is an ideal dirt race around the same time as the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A big dirt race held around the same time as the Takarazuka Kinen…
choice_data_list: You're thinking of the Japan Dirt Derby.
You're thinking of the Japan Dirt Derby.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well done. It seems you have the field already scoped out.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Please give it some consideration, as reciprocation for the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Reciprocation… So, I'm in debt to Opera O and Doto…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I've got to be there!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The starlit track… The heart-catching course that illuminates the love in couples' hearts—a second Tokyo!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's right. Let's run in the Japan Dirt Derby. I want to show Opera O and Doto what I can do, of course. But it's not only that…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I have to find out if that sparkle… that intensity I saw today at the NHK Mile Cup…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I have to know if it's the same at G1 dirt races too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Thank you! This time, let us behold the powerful Umas who cavort across the dirt!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm not picky about tracks or pairings! I'll take whatever's put in front of me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't really get that last part… But either way, it looks like we have our sights set on the G1 Japan Dirt Derby next!
